LanguageData.CBF_AllBuildableHelp: Gives every building that has no architect category of its own one, so you can place it from the architect menu instead of crafting and installing it. In Medieval Overhaul that is 258 things: rugs, statues, ruin pieces, hideout furniture. Things without build cost are skipped, they would be free. Takes effect after a restart. Open build orders for these buildings are cancelled when you switch this off or remove CBF, and the materials are returned.
